name: wraps-email
description: Send email through your own Amazon SES account, and check domains, suppressions and sandbox status.
long_description: Works with any Amazon SES account: send email, check domain verification and DKIM, look up the suppression list, and see whether the account is still in the SES sandbox. With a Wraps email stack deployed, it also reads send history and delivery events. Your AWS credentials are read locally and never transmitted to Wraps.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Region your Wraps stack is deployed in. SES identities are per-region. Optional if your AWS profile already supplies one.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: AWS profile to use. Credentials are read locally and never leave your machine.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a transactional email via your AWS SES account.

tools.name: list_recent_sends
tools.description: List recently sent emails from your Wraps email history, newest first, at most `limit` messages.

tools.name: get_email_event_log
tools.description: Get the full delivery event log for a specific email by its messageId.

tools.name: verify_domain_status
tools.description: Check the verification and DKIM status of a sending domain in your AWS SES account.

tools.name: list_suppressions
tools.description: List addresses on your AWS SES account-level suppression list, or check a single address with `email`.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Check this AWS SES account's sandbox status and get a recommended next action for getting a first send out.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the monthly cost of sending email with Wraps + AWS: the flat Wraps plan fee and an itemized AWS bill (SES, EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, DynamoDB, dedicated IP, WAF).
